mapper.select: SELECT ts.id, ts.tenant_id, ts.plan_id, ts.billing_cycle, ts.status, ts.trial_start_date, ts.trial_end_date, ts.current_period_start, ts.current_period_end, ts.stripe_subscription_id, ts.stripe_customer_id, ts.created_at, ts.updated_at, sp.plan_code, sp.plan_name_en, sp.plan_name_zh, sp.monthly_price, sp.yearly_price, sp.max_users, sp.max_staff, sp.max_appointments_per_month, sp.trial_days, sp.is_active, sp.features as plan_features, sp.created_at as plan_created_at, sp.updated_at as plan_updated_at FROM tenant_subscriptions ts LEFT JOIN subscription_plans sp ON ts.plan_id = sp.id WHERE ts.id = #{id}

SELECT ts.id, ts.tenant_id, ts.plan_id, ts.billing_cycle, ts.status, ts.trial_start_date, ts.trial_end_date, ts.current_period_start, ts.current_period_end, ts.stripe_subscription_id, ts.stripe_customer_id, ts.created_at, ts.updated_at, sp.plan_code, sp.plan_name_en, sp.plan_name_zh, sp.monthly_price, sp.yearly_price, sp.max_users, sp.max_staff, sp.max_appointments_per_month, sp.trial_days, sp.is_active, sp.features as plan_features, sp.created_at as plan_created_at, sp.updated_at as plan_updated_at FROM tenant_subscriptions ts LEFT JOIN subscription_plans sp ON ts.plan_id = sp.id WHERE ts.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ts.status IN ('TRIAL', 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY ts.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ts.id, ts.tenant_id, ts.plan_id, ts.billing_cycle, ts.status, ts.trial_start_date, ts.trial_end_date, ts.current_period_start, ts.current_period_end, ts.stripe_subscription_id, ts.stripe_customer_id, ts.created_at, ts.updated_at, sp.plan_code, sp.plan_name_en, sp.plan_name_zh, sp.monthly_price, sp.yearly_price, sp.max_users, sp.max_staff, sp.max_appointments_per_month, sp.trial_days, sp.is_active, sp.features as plan_features, sp.created_at as plan_created_at, sp.updated_at as plan_updated_at FROM tenant_subscriptions ts LEFT JOIN subscription_plans sp ON ts.plan_id = sp.id WHERE ts.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY ts.created_at DESC

SELECT ts.id, ts.tenant_id, ts.plan_id, ts.billing_cycle, ts.status, ts.trial_start_date, ts.trial_end_date, ts.current_period_start, ts.current_period_end, ts.stripe_subscription_id, ts.stripe_customer_id, ts.created_at, ts.updated_at, sp.plan_code, sp.plan_name_en, sp.plan_name_zh, sp.monthly_price, sp.yearly_price, sp.max_users, sp.max_staff, sp.max_appointments_per_month, sp.trial_days, sp.is_active, sp.features as plan_features, sp.created_at as plan_created_at, sp.updated_at as plan_updated_at FROM tenant_subscriptions ts LEFT JOIN subscription_plans sp ON ts.plan_id = sp.id WHERE ts.status = 'TRIAL' ORDER BY ts.trial_end_date ASC

SELECT ts.id, ts.tenant_id, ts.plan_id, ts.billing_cycle, ts.status, ts.trial_start_date, ts.trial_end_date, ts.current_period_start, ts.current_period_end, ts.stripe_subscription_id, ts.stripe_customer_id, ts.created_at, ts.updated_at, sp.plan_code, sp.plan_name_en, sp.plan_name_zh, sp.monthly_price, sp.yearly_price, sp.max_users, sp.max_staff, sp.max_appointments_per_month, sp.trial_days, sp.is_active, sp.features as plan_features, sp.created_at as plan_created_at, sp.updated_at as plan_updated_at FROM tenant_subscriptions ts LEFT JOIN subscription_plans sp ON ts.plan_id = sp.id WHERE ts.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ts.current_period_end ASC
